title: Siree Raag, First Mehla:
subtitle: Siree Raag · Ang 17
summary: Gratitude is carried here from siree Raag, First Mehla: toward o Nanak, the True King absorbs us into Himself.
whyItMatters: This shabad is useful when life feels dull, entitled, forgetful, because it keeps gratitude inside remembrance, conduct, and the Creator's larger care instead of private mood.
takeaway: Gratitude steadies when o Nanak, the True King absorbs us into Himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਹੁ ਭੈਣੇ ਗਲਿ ਮਿਲਹ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਹੇਲੜੀਆਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: aavahu bhaine gal mileh a(n)k sahelaReeaaeh ||
lines.translation: Come, my dear sisters and spiritual companions; hug me close in your embrace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਕੈ ਕਰਹ ਕਹਾਣੀਆ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥ ਕੰਤ ਕੀਆਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: mil kai kareh kahaaneeaa sa(n)mrath ka(n)t keeaaeh ||
lines.translation: Let's join together, and tell stories of our All-powerful Husband Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਭਿ ਗੁਣ ਅਉਗਣ ਸਭਿ ਅਸਾਹ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: saache saahib sabh gun aaugan sabh asaeh ||1||
lines.translation: All Virtues are in our True Lord and Master; we are utterly without virtue. ||1||
O Creator Lord, all are in Your Power.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਜਾ ਤੂ ਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ek sabadh beechaareeaai jaa too taa kiaa hor ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I dwell upon the One Word of the Shabad. You are mine-what else do I need? ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਇ ਪੁਛਹੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਤੁਸੀ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਕਿਨੀ ਗੁਣਂੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jai puchhahu sohaaganee tusee raaviaa kinee guna(n)ee ||
lines.translation: Go, and ask the happy soul-brides, ""By what virtuous qualities do you enjoy your Husband Lord?""
"We are adorned with intuitive ease, contentment and sweet words.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਰੀਸਾਲੂ ਤਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: pir reesaaloo taa milai jaa gur kaa sabadh sunee ||2||
lines.translation: We meet with our Beloved, the Source of Joy, when we listen to the Word of the Guru's Shabad.""||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੀਆ ਤੇਰੀਆ ਕੁਦਰਤੀ ਕੇਵਡ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: keteeaa tereeaa kudharatee kevadd teree dhaat ||
lines.translation: You have so many Creative Powers, Lord; Your Bountiful Blessings are so Great.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kete tere jeea ja(n)t sifat kareh dhin raat ||
lines.translation: So many of Your beings and creatures praise You day and night.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਕੇਤੇ ਜਾਤਿ ਅਜਾਤਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: kete tere roop ra(n)g kete jaat ajaat ||3||
lines.translation: You have so many forms and colors, so many classes, high and low. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਸਚ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach milai sach uoopajai sach meh saach samai ||
lines.translation: Meeting the True One, Truth wells up. The truthful are absorbed into the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਤਿ ਊਗਵੈ ਗੁਰਬਚਨੀ ਭਉ ਖਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: surat hovai pat uoogavai gurbachanee bhau khai ||
lines.translation: Intuitive understanding is obtained and one is welcomed with honor, through the Guru's Word, filled with the Fear of God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sachaa paatisaahu aape le milai ||4||10||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the True King absorbs us into Himself. ||4||10||

structure: The opening movement names the pressure directly: siree Raag, First Mehla:.
The middle movement deepens the correction by holding the mind inside "We are adorned with intuitive ease, contentment and sweet words.
The closing movement leaves a return you can actually keep: o Nanak, the True King absorbs us into Himself.
